summary: First full pass of TRAVOO. Backend: 23 pytest cases covering auth, locations (incl. native-script aliases, PIN, OSM), driver verification + admin approval + instant-approval mode, vehicles, trip publish/search/alt-dates, instant + request booking, overbooking, concurrent accepts, duplicate/own-ride guards, cancellations with seat restore + ledger reversal, trip cancel, start/complete, earnings (700x3=2100), settle idempotency, reviews, chat gating, notifications, tickets, admin. Sequential run: 23/23 passed. Under parallel load, the concurrent-settle test failed once in 2 runs (race condition). Frontend (390x844): onboarding -> register (consent error shown) -> home -> location modal (Bangalore alias) -> Find a Ride -> results/sort -> trip detail -> UPI booking -> confirmation shows 'Pay your driver directly by Cash or UPI.' + driver UPI -> cancel all work. Hindi/Tamil/Urdu switching changes UI text, and Urdu turns on RTL. Offer publish flow (origin/dest/pickup/drop/date/time/price/instant switch/preview/publish), driver My rides -> accept/reject/settle UPI/start/complete, and earnings (Rs900) work. Admin dashboard CRASHED with 'data.map is not a function' when switching from Overview to Drivers (or any list tab). I fixed this in admin.tsx and retested: all 9 tabs, driver approve and the instant-approval switch now work. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: Settling is check-then-set, not atomic. 4 concurrent settle calls returned [200,409,200,409] and inserted 2 rows into db.settlements for one booking (1 of 2 runs). Summary totals are still correct because they come from booking.settlement and the ledger has a unique index, but the settlements history gets duplicate rows. Fix: update_one({booking_id, 'settlement.status': {$ne:'received'}}) and check modified_count before inserting.

The duplicate-booking check (find_one, then insert) is not atomic and there is no unique partial index on (trip_id, passenger_id, active status). Two concurrent requests from the same passenger can create 2 bookings.

If a driver has already marked a confirmed booking as 'received' and it is then cancelled, the settlement stays 'received' and still counts in the cash/upi totals in /api/earnings. No reversal or flag is recorded.
Approves any user_id, even one with no driver_documents or driver_status not 'under_review'. It should require a submitted verification.

ui_bugs.issue: CRASH (FIXED BY TESTER): switching from Overview to Drivers/Users/etc. rendered the new tab with the old tab's stats object, so data.map threw and the ErrorBoundary showed 'Something went wrong'. Root cause: setData(null) runs in useEffect after the render that uses the new tab. Fix: added dataTab state and only render when dataTab === tab. A remaining edge case is that a slow response from an earlier tab can overwrite newer data; consider an abort/requestId guard.
The trip edit button label uses t('profile.edit') and shows 'Edit profile' on the trip page. It should say 'Edit ride'. Reference: app/trip/[id].tsx:186

In the web preview, Urdu glyphs render as disconnected letters (e.g. tab labels, hero, auth). The likely cause is that the custom PJS (Plus Jakarta Sans) fontFamily has no Arabic-script glyphs, so fallback shaping breaks. Verify on a device and bundle Noto Nastaliq Urdu / Noto Naskh Arabic for ur/ks/sd (and possibly Noto fonts for Indic scripts). Urdu CTA labels are also truncated ('رائیڈ تلاش ...').
When a field is missing, the error text is only the field label (e.g. 'Date' or 'Pickup point / Drop-off point'), not a proper message. Reference: app/(tabs)/offer.tsx:96-99

issues: Plural grammar: '1 rides found', '1 seats left', '1 Seats · ₹450', '2/3 Seats'
'How will you pay?: UPI' has double punctuation
The hero image is a US-southwest desert with a VW van, which doesn't fit an Indian intercity carpooling app. Use an Indian highway/city image.

action_items: Make /bookings/{bid}/settle atomic (conditional update on settlement.status, then insert settlement only if modified)
Add a unique partial index or atomic guard against concurrent duplicate bookings by the same passenger on the same trip
Decide how to handle a settled booking that is later cancelled (reverse it, or flag it in earnings)
Fix trip-edit-button label (app/trip/[id].tsx:186): use a trip edit i18n key, not profile.edit
Bundle Arabic-script fonts (Noto Nastaliq Urdu / Naskh) for ur/ks/sd and skip the PJS fontFamily for those languages; check CTA truncation in RTL
Add pluralization (i18n count forms) for rides/seats and fix the 'Passengers 1' placeholder and 'How will you pay?:' punctuation
Give proper validation messages in the Offer form
Replace the home hero image with one relevant to India
Admin review endpoint: require a submitted verification before approving
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1215 lines; split into auth/locations/trips/bookings/earnings/admin routers
admin.tsx: single shared `data` state across tabs caused the crash; consider react-query with per-tab keys (QueryClientProvider is already mounted)
Seat reservation via find_one_and_update with $gte guard is correct; the concurrent accept test passed (one 200, one 409, seats=1)
A suspended user's existing JWT is correctly rejected (401/403) and their login returns 403

success_rate.backend: 100% sequential (23/23); concurrent settle race flaky (1/2 runs)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (admin crash fixed by tester; all other requested flows passed)

rca_of_issue: Admin crash: in admin.tsx the tab change re-renders before the useEffect that clears data, so body() runs case 'drivers' with the stats object and calls data.map, which throws a TypeError caught by the ErrorBoundary. Reproduced via admin login -> /admin -> tap Drivers. Mitigation: track which tab the data belongs to (dataTab) and show Loading until it matches.
